verdict.rationale: Airwallex is documented only as a hosted financial platform reached through APIs, SDKs, webhooks and a vendor-run sandbox. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable, on-premises or open-source deployment of the core product. Self-hosting is a fair question for payments and billing software, so the axis applies. The sandbox is a hosted test environment, not self-hosting, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
